honors.title: Spot Beam Award
honors.description:
A Spot Beam is a focused satellite signal sent to a geographical area within a satellite's area of coverage.   A satellite can have multiple spot beams within its footprint.  Spot Beams are used by satellites to deliver certain transponder signals to geographically well-defined areas.  SSL has extremely bright and talented individuals, who shine brightly and make a lasting impression on our success.   

This top award is given to a limited number of employees each quarter.  The nominations require a director and VP level signature and are reviewed by a committee.  Winners are honored in a variety of ways to ensure that their accomplishments are well known within SSL.
honors.issuer: Issued by Space Systems Loral · Feb 2017

projects.title: Budget Institutions and the Positive Theory of Fiscal Policy (Dissertation)
projects.description: This study examines the effects of budget institutions (i.e. the set of protocols and practices used to draft, approve, and implement budgets) on fiscal policy outcomes. It creates three original composite measures of budget institutions from survey responses to over 200 questions answered by budget officials in 97 countries. It also constructs an original dataset comprising 76 economic, social, and political indicators from 14 different sources, and covers each country over the period 1997-2007.  The study utilizes six econometric models to examine the ways in which the strength of fiscal rules, the level of fiscal transparency, and the collegiality of procedural rules, are associated with the size of government, the composition of expenditures, as well as deficit levels and central government debt. The analysis finds support for 8 of 13 predictions, resulting in a 62% success rate. It is the largest such study to date, in terms of both country and regional coverage, and the most comprehensive in scope with regard to the set of policy outcomes examined.
